FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of April 14, 2026 between Pinecrest Maple Studio LLC, a Colorado limited liability company with its office at 88 Alder Street, Boulder, Colorado ("Client"), and Tobias Ndlovu-Reyes, an individual residing in Austin, Texas ("Contractor").

1. Scope of Work

1.1 Contractor will design and deliver a brand identity package for Client consisting of a logo in three variations, a color palette, a typography guide, and a one-page usage sheet (the "Deliverables").

1.2 The Deliverables are limited to the items listed in Section 1.1, and any additional work requires a written change order signed by both parties that states the added fee and schedule.

1.3 The fee includes two rounds of revisions to the logo concepts, and each further round will be billed at the rate of $85 per hour.

1.4 Contractor will deliver the first concepts within fifteen business days after the Effective Date, and Client will give consolidated feedback within five business days after each delivery.

1.5 Contractor is an independent contractor and controls the manner and means of the work, including its hours and equipment.

2. Fees and Payment

2.1 Client will pay Contractor a fixed fee of $9,600 for the Deliverables (the "Fee").

2.2 Contractor will invoice 50 percent of the Fee on signing and 50 percent on delivery of the final files, and Client will pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

2.3 Any amount not paid when due will accrue interest at 1.5 percent per month, or the highest rate allowed by law if lower, until it is paid.

2.4 Client will reimburse pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses, such as stock font licenses, within thirty days of receiving an invoice with receipts.

3. Ownership of Work

3.1 Upon Client's payment of the Fee in full, Contractor assigns to Client all rights in the Deliverables that are created specifically for Client under this Agreement.

3.2 Contractor keeps ownership of all of her pre-existing tools, templates, code, fonts, and methods, and of any general know-how she uses or develops, and grants Client a non-exclusive, perpetual license to use any such material that is embedded in the Deliverables as part of the Deliverables.

3.3 Contractor may display the Deliverables in her portfolio after Client has publicly released them.

3.4 Until payment is made in full, Contractor retains ownership of the Deliverables and grants Client a limited license to review them.

4. Termination

4.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving fourteen days of written notice to the other party.

4.2 If Client terminates for convenience, Client will pay Contractor for all work performed through the termination date, plus a kill fee equal to 20 percent of the unpaid balance of the Fee.

4.3 If Contractor terminates for convenience, Contractor will deliver all completed work to Client, and Client will pay only for the portion of the work delivered.

4.4 Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other party materially breaches it and does not cure the breach within ten days of notice.

5. Indemnity and Liability

5.1 Each party will indemnify the other against third-party claims arising from its own breach of this Agreement, and the indemnifying party's total liability under this Section will not exceed the Fees paid or payable under this Agreement.

5.2 The indemnified party will give prompt written notice of any claim and reasonable cooperation in its defense.

5.3 Each party's total liability to the other arising out of this Agreement, under any theory, will not exceed the Fees paid or payable under this Agreement.

5.4 Neither party will be liable to the other for lost profits or indirect damages.

6. Changes and Notices

6.1 This Agreement may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties.

6.2 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the addresses each party has provided in writing.

7. General

7.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Colorado, without regard to its conflict of laws rules.

7.2 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject and replaces all earlier discussions and understandings.

7.3 If a court finds any provision unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in effect, and the parties will replace the unenforceable provision with a valid one that is as close as possible to its intent.

7.4 Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.

7.5 The parties will try in good faith to resolve any dispute through direct discussion before either begins legal proceedings, and either party may then bring an action in the state or federal courts located in Boulder County, Colorado.

7.6 The failure of either party to enforce a provision of this Agreement is not a waiver of that provision.

7.7 This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, and all counterparts together form one document.

7.8 The Effective Date of this Agreement is the date of the last signature below.
